title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at Quantum eMotion, Qtonic Quantum, Chicago Quantum Exchange, and Equal1 - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Quantum eMotion Corp. has appointed Wayne Teeple as Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Teeple, who has served on QeM’s Board of Directors since 2021, brings more than 30 years of cybersecurity, defense, and technology leadership experience, including founding and scaling Phirelight Security Solutions (acquired by RHEA Group). In his new role, Teeple will lead the company’s technology strategy, product development roadmap, and technical integration efforts across its QRNG, SecureKey, Sentry-Q, and eShield-Q platforms, while overseeing technical alignment for QeM’s proposed acquisition of Plurilock Security Inc. The complete announcement can be accessed here.

Qtonic Quantum Corp. has appointed retired Lieutenant General Roger L. Cloutier Jr., U.S. Army, to lead company operations. Cloutier previously commanded NATO Allied Land Command and has chaired Qtonic Quantum’s Allied Defense Council since May 2026. He will oversee operational execution and organizational scale as federal migration mandates take effect under Executive Order 14412, guiding the deployment of Qtonic’s cryptographic discovery and migration platforms (QScout and QSolve). Cloutier joins a senior advisory and executive team that includes retired general officers Mark Weatherington, Milford Beagle Jr., and Shan Bagby. The full press release is available here.

Chicago Quantum Exchange (CQE) has named Dr. Aaron Fluitt as its second Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Kate Timmerman. Fluitt brings deep expertise across national laboratories, strategy consulting, and industry, having previously served as Senior Director for Technology Partnerships at PsiQuantum and helping lead Argonne National Laboratory’s initiative that established the $115 million DOE Q-NEXT quantum research center. As CEO, Fluitt will lead CQE’s efforts to expand the Midwest quantum workforce and scale the domestic quantum manufacturing supply chain through the CQE-led Bloch Quantum Tech Hub. The official announcement can be found here.

Equal1 has appointed semiconductor and operations executive Andrew Flynn as Chief Operating Officer (COO). Flynn brings more than two decades of operational, supply chain, and manufacturing leadership across the semiconductor sector, having previously held senior positions at Qorvo, Decawave, and Xilinx. In his new capacity, Flynn will oversee global operations, quality systems, and supply chain scaling as Equal1 accelerates commercialization of RacQ, its rack-mounted quantum computer. Details of the appointment are accessible here.

We wish all these organizations and individuals success in their new endeavors.
